entities.summary: Jan Hus, a notable figure in the history of Czechia, associated with Charles IV & the Luxemburg Golden Age (1402–1437). Preceded by Golden Bull of 1356 issued from Prague and Charles University founded. Their legacy influenced Jan Hus burned at stake at Council of Constance and Battle of Vítkov Hill — Žižka defeats Crusader army.
